<!-- pr-reviewer: 657f998bbc96699d5c1d3e56bac7ae36629a7107 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

Reviewed against #1201 ("Wanted" 1-3 and "Done means") and AGENTS.md, trial-merged with `origin/main` (8060358, clean merge) in a separate worktree.

### What looks good
- Detection reads `HEAD` + `git --no-optional-locks status --porcelain` in `Run::new`, before every step and at the end (`xtask/src/exec.rs:154-162`). VOID prints a named line, skips the remaining steps, and `summary` returns 1 with `== gate VOID`. Every tier goes through `Run`, including `gate test <name>` (`main.rs:153`) and the in-process release gate (`release.rs:193`). The release command's own bump and commits come after `gate()` (`release.rs:131-133`), so they cannot void it.
- `--dry-run` is unaffected: the readings are taken and compared, no step runs, and it exits 0.
- The comparison is a pure function (`xtask/src/checkout.rs`). The six tests pin the three real cases from today (HEAD moved, half-moved with HEAD unchanged, both moved), plus the cap on listed entries and short-SHA safety. No `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic!` outside tests. A missing `git` or a directory that is not a repo gives a clean `Err` from `Run::new`, and a read failure mid-run becomes a VOID rather than a crash. Only `std::process::Command("git")` is used, with no shell.
- "Wanted 3" (the lock/hook) is decided and recorded in `docs/decisions/1201-gate-checkout-guard.md`: detection only, with the reasons for dropping the hook and the index lock. This matches the finding in the issue comment.
- Process text: the new AGENTS.md bullet and the `work-issue` step both say a worktree agent never switches, pulls, merges, resets, checks out or stashes in the main checkout, and both give the reason. No other AGENTS.md line changed, and the maintainer's quoted sentences are intact. `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` 29 -> 30 (main is still at 29). No workflow or trigger changes. No `CHANGELOG.md` edit. `Changelog: none` and `Fixes #1201` are present. Provenance lines are on both new files.

### Local results (merged with main)
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p xtask` | 55 passed, 0 failed (includes the 6 `checkout_tests`) |
| `cargo clippy -p xtask --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main --dry-run` | plan printed, exit 0 |
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main` (real) | 1/1 ok, exit 0: **the gate does not void itself** |
| End to end: untracked file created mid-run | `== gate VOID`, exit 1 |
| End to end: HEAD moved mid-run (local empty commit) | `VOID: the checkout moved from abc0c1b5 to 9ef41a7d ... (at the end)`, exit 1 |
| End to end: half-moved (staged change, HEAD unchanged) | `VOID: the working tree of abc0c1b5 changed (1 entry differs: M  README.md) ...`, exit 1 |
| `.git/index.lock` present (scratch repo) | `git --no-optional-locks status --porcelain` and `rev-parse HEAD` both exit 0 in about 0.3 s, no hang |

False-void audit of what a healthy run writes into the checkout: `gate-logs/`, `target/`, `*.log`, `*.new.png` / `*.diff.png` and `.claude/**` (locks, worktrees) are all gitignored. `crates/ui/build.rs` writes nothing into the tree. Golden writers in `crates/app/tests` write only under `WRITE_GOLDEN`, which no tier sets. Other test file writes go to `temp_dir()`. Release bump and commits happen after the gate. None of these can void a healthy run.

### Requested before merge
None.

### Questions / notes (not blocking)
1. A stale `Cargo.lock` (a `Cargo.toml` change without its lock) is rewritten by the first cargo step, so the run reports VOID and names `M Cargo.lock`. That is arguably right, since the tree did change, but the message tells the reader to "re-run on a checkout nobody pulls into", which points the wrong way in that case. A follow-up could tell the two apart. P7 if wanted.
2. Any untracked, non-ignored file dropped in the main checkout during a batch run (scratch output, a stray `*.txt`) voids it. This is intended and written up under "Known limit" in the decision file. Briefs that write scratch files should keep them in the scratchpad or under `.claude/`.
3. The AGENTS.md bullet names `C:\...\Claude-001`. AGENTS.md is shared with forks on other machines and OSes, so "the main checkout (the clone the maintainer works in)" would read better there.
4. The PR body says "54 + 6 new". The merged tree has 55 xtask tests in total (49 + 6). Only the body is off.
5. #1201 "Wanted 3" says to remove the hand-made local `reference-transaction` hook if it does not prove itself, and the decision drops it. That is a local action in the maintainer's clone, not part of this PR.
6. Not exercised: the "before step N" VOID path in a multi-step plan (the real runs were one step, so they hit "at the end"; the code path is the same `check`). Not run on macOS or Linux.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
